podcast.title: Geographical Origin
podcast.body: The Asexuals were a hardcore punk band from Montreal, Canada. "Montreal gave us the asexuals."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Origins in Montreal
podcast.body: The Asexuals are highlighted as a significant hardcore band originating from Montreal, contributing to the Canadian hardcore scene. "Montreal gave us the asexuals."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
